content.rationale: Verification is where the assembled file meets its checker: run `quint typecheck specs/store_bulk/check.qnt && quint verify specs/store_bulk/check.qnt --main=store_bulk --invariant=ResultsMatchReference,DivergenceFallsBack,FallbackTotal,Totality,SingleBatch --max-steps=10` — grammar plus types first, then bounded-exhaustive invariants over all traces to the bound. The invariants pin the result equality against the single-document read, the divergent-id fallback, the whole-set fallback under an unavailable mapping or git, totality at Done, and at most one batch. Runs green at placement and whenever the model changes (verify needs a JDK for its Apalache backend; typecheck does not).
